title: Flame
body:
I always feel the urge to write when traveling. Mostly on airplanes, I don't know why. Maybe because this flying up high takes me out of my box: as if I'm getting a breath of fresh air. Today I didn't know why I pulled out my notebook to write, I always carry it with me but rarely use it. As if I'm afraid that when that damn inspiration comes, I won't have paper to turn it into words. As if everything revolves around her. Which her? I don't know how to answer. Foivos's "Her" perhaps: who is everything, always and everywhere; whom you love, you fight for, you sacrifice yourself for and in the end you get killed. And then, like another Prometheus, you are born again and she eats your liver all over again, punishing you like that for the sin of taking the flame from God and sharing it. You turn the inexplicable and unpredictable divine into something simple and clear. And that, afterwards, eats your liver. Tension. Heart.
I don't know who you are, while you only saw some Giorgos giving you a little piece of paper from a notebook that speaks of arsons and miracles. Flame. Tension. These came to my mind when our eyes met. You didn't speak. Tension. But you gave me a sweet smile, as if telling me "thank you for your paper, even though I don't yet know what it contains." Tension. I missed my stop. Syntagma carried me away.
Now I sit bound and Synthesizing [Syntasso] on a rusty power distribution box, humanizing the divine. Like another eagle, it will eat my liver. Then, I will be born again. But the Metro will have already left by then.
Tension.
like another eagle, I just woke up flying over flaming and flooded Athens;
inside a narrow airplane.

y.f.
